description: This file defines the 'ExecApprovalEvaluation' structure and the 'ExecApprovalEvaluator' enum, which contains static methods for evaluating command execution approvals within an application. It includes logic for security checks, allowlist evaluations, and auto-allowance of skills based on trusted binaries.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Asynchronously evaluates a command for approval, considering security policies, allowlist status, and auto-allow rules, returning an ExecApprovalEvaluation object.

methods.name: isSkillAutoAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a set of command resolutions are auto-allowed based on trusted binary bins.

methods.name: _testIsSkillAutoAllowed
methods.description: Unit test wrapper for 'isSkillAutoAllowed' function, used for internal testing.
